clue.text: The right furniture

definitions.meaning: a fixture or piece of equipment in a room

explanation.definitionFit: Fitting means proper or suitable, and a fitting is also an item fixed into a house, part of its furnishing.

clue.text: Scoffed at by Florence encountering aristocratic Edward

parts.note: Flo is short for the name Florence
U means upper-class, the usage of the aristocracy
Ted is a pet form of Edward

explanation.surface: Florence meets a noble Edward and is mocked.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class comes from Nancy Mitford's 'U and non-U' usage.
explanation.definitionFit: To flout is to treat with contempt or mock, so flouted means scoffed at.

clue.text: Room for the German in the untidy attic'? Shocking !

indicators.note: the German room is put inside the jumbled attic
an untidy attic is one with its contents, here its letters, in disorder

parts.note: Raum is the German word for room

explanation.surface: Room for a German lodger in a messy attic would be appalling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'untidy' muddles the attic's letters to TATIC, and 'in' puts the German word inside after its T; the question mark marks the German lodger as fanciful.
explanation.definitionFit: Traumatic means deeply distressing, a synonym of shocking.

clue.text: Bull in a stew ?

parts.note: an ... bull is a self-contradictory statement, and ... stew is a mutton dish

explanation.definitionFit: Both an Irish bull, a laughable logical blunder, and Irish stew take the same nationality as their adjective.

clue.text: " Glories, like ——, afar off shine bright " (Webster)

parts.note: the quotation from Webster's The Duchess of Malfi compares glories to small insects that glow at a distance

explanation.definitionFit: Webster's lines run 'Glories, like glow-worms, afar off shine bright, But looked to near, have neither heat nor light'.

clue.text: I'm in the linen-weaver's grasp, says the seaman

indicators.note: the letter is placed in the weaver's name, the grasp holding it

parts.note: Silas Marner is the linen-weaver of George Eliot's novel
I'm, read as 'I am', gives the letter I

explanation.surface: A voice speaks from inside a weaver's clutches, apparently a sailor's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'grasp' both say the I sits within MARNER, the weaver of Raveloe in Silas Marner; 'says' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A mariner is a sailor, one who works at sea.

clue.text: Handy equipment for bunglers

definitions.meaning: fur tubes to keep the hands warm
a clumsy person who fumbles a catch is called by the same word

explanation.definitionFit: A muff keeps the hands warm, and a muff is also a clumsy person who fumbles a catch.

clue.text: Green hair, re-set, can be something of a trial!

indicators.note: hair that is re-set is arranged again, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Dyed and restyled hair might be an ordeal to sit through.
explanation.walkthrough: 're-set' rearranges GREENHAIR; 'can be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A rehearing is a second hearing of a case, so part of a legal trial.

clue.text: Figures of perfection

parts.note: numerals as figures, and the idiom 'dressed to the ___' for perfection

explanation.definitionFit: Dressed up to the nines means to perfection, and nines are also numbers.

clue.text: Jackets needed when a storm blows up

definitions.text: Jackets needed when a storm blows up

parts.words: Jackets needed when a storm blows up
parts.note: short thick sailors' coats, and also those who shorten sail in a storm

explanation.definitionFit: A reefer is a sailor's thick jacket, and reefers are also those who take in sail when the wind rises.

clue.text: It's correct with a good beast

parts.note: OK means all right, correct
PI, short for pious, is the crossword stand-in for good

explanation.surface: A remark that something is right, with a good animal attached.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi is an African animal related to the giraffe.

clue.text: Possibility of the right kind of game ?

parts.note: in cricket the off side is the right side for a right-handed batsman
a game of chance, decided by luck rather than skill

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a game is the proper sort.
explanation.walkthrough: OFF is the cricket word for the side of the field facing a right-handed batsman, the right-hand side.
explanation.definitionFit: An off-chance is a slight possibility, an outside hope.

clue.text: A predator among cats calls for weapons

indicators.note: the predator is placed among the cats, inside their letters

parts.note: toms are male cats
a hawk is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A bird of prey caught among cats demands arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'among' sets A and the predator inside the cats; 'calls for' is a link, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Tomahawks are the light axes used as weapons by Native Americans.

clue.text: I will be heard in church

indicators.note: the contraction of the words before, spoken aloud, gives the sound of the answer

parts.note: I will contracts to I'll

explanation.surface: Someone promises their voice will carry in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be heard' signals the sound: I'll, the contraction of 'I will', is said like the church passage.
explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is the passage between the pews of a church.

clue.text: Engagements prove a setback to the District Attorney

parts.note: read as 'set back', the word set written backwards

explanation.surface: Appointments turn out to be a blow to the prosecutor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setback' must be split into 'set back': the word set turned round, giving TES, follows the prosecutor's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Dates are appointments or engagements, especially social ones.

clue.text: Fake diamonds of 3 origin

definitions.note: the national emblem of the country named by the answer to 3-down

parts.note: a sham is a fake
rocks is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: Paste jewels said to come from a particular country.
explanation.walkthrough: '3' points to 3-down; that clue's answer is a nationality, and these plants are that country's emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: The trefoil plants are the national symbol of Ireland, so are plants of Irish origin.

clue.text: Reverse it, as a gun-dog does

definitions.meaning: to retrieve a loss or a situation is to undo it, recover from it
a gun-dog fetches the shot game back to the shooter

explanation.definitionFit: To retrieve is to recover or set right a bad position, and also what a dog does in fetching shot birds.

clue.text: Bridges made his of beauty

parts.note: the poet laureate Robert Bridges wrote the long poem The ___ of Beauty

explanation.definitionFit: Robert Bridges' last great poem is The Testament of Beauty, published in 1929.

clue.text: Not much weight is attached to such illumination

definitions.text: Not much weight is attached to such illumination

parts.words: Not much weight is attached to such illumination
parts.note: a flare fired from a pistol, named after its inventor, and a phrase meaning hardly heavy

explanation.definitionFit: A Very light is a coloured signal flare, named after Edward Very, and also reads as 'extremely light'.

clue.text: Donkeymen ?

parts.note: read as male donkeys, a jack being the male; the word also means fools

explanation.definitionFit: A jack is a male donkey, so male asses are 'donkey men', and the word also means foolish people.

clue.text: Flower for an admitted Jacobite ?

parts.note: a supporter of King James owning his loyalty might say 'Jas. is my king', with Jas. the abbreviation for James

explanation.definitionFit: Jasmine is a fragrant flowering shrub; split as JAS MINE it is a Jacobite's declaration that James is theirs.

clue.text: Ferdinand engages in sharp practice

parts.note: Ferdinand is the bull of the children's story, and a bull's sharp practice is with its horns

explanation.definitionFit: A bull gores, piercing with its horns, which is the sharp practice the clue means.

clue.text: Broken rest after a fling for a dubious practitioner

indicators.note: the broken rest comes after the fling, so placed second

parts.note: a shy is a throw or fling, as at a coconut shy

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A night's rest is disturbed after a wild time, for some disreputable figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broken' rearranges REST into STER, and 'after' puts it behind the throw; 'for a' is a link. A coconut shy is a fairground stall where balls are flung at coconuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A shyster is an unscrupulous professional, especially a crooked lawyer.

clue.text: Extra splendid

explanation.definitionFit: A super is a walk-on actor, an extra in a crowd scene, and super also means excellent.

clue.text: Painful situation for a lovely ?

parts.note: a glamour picture is fixed to the wall, as if a pretty girl were pinned there

explanation.definitionFit: A pin-up is a picture of an attractive person pinned to a wall, which sounds painful for her.

clue.text: Proceed with all the stops out in a jocular way

parts.note: to play is to go on with a game or performance
with every organ stop drawn, so fully, to the utmost

explanation.surface: An organist told to go ahead at full blast, all in fun.
explanation.walkthrough: Pulling out all an organ's stops is playing it as fully as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: Playfully means in a joking, light-hearted manner.

clue.text: Flowers one pierces with a sword

definitions.meaning: to pink is to prick or stab with a sword point

explanation.definitionFit: Pinks are small fragrant dianthus flowers, and a fencer pinks an opponent by piercing with the point.

clue.text: Wild but flourished round a certain period

indicators.note: the abbreviation goes round the period, enclosing it

parts.note: fl. is the abbreviation of floruit, flourished, used in dating historical figures
an era is a period of history

explanation.surface: Untamed, yet thriving through a particular stretch of time.
explanation.walkthrough: fl. is the scholar's abbreviation for floruit, seen in dates like 'fl. 1650'; 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Feral means wild, especially of an animal gone back from domestication.

clue.text: The age of Reynolds

parts.note: Sir Joshua Reynolds painted The Age of ..., a portrait of a small girl

explanation.definitionFit: The Age of Innocence is a famous painting by Sir Joshua Reynolds, so his 'age' is that quality of childish purity.

clue.text: Desirable Mister

parts.note: the ideal partner is called Mr ___, the man one hopes to marry

explanation.definitionFit: Mr Right is the idiom for the ideal man to marry, the most desirable mister.

clue.text: There's no protection with French revelations

definitions.meaning: exposés, a word taken from French, are revelations of scandal

explanation.definitionFit: To expose something is to leave it unprotected, and exposés, borrowed from French, are published revelations.

clue.text: The satellite, it appears, keeps the sailor informed

indicators.note: the satellite's name presents itself as a sentence when said, so it seems to say this

parts.note: tells (keeps informed) the tar, a sailor

explanation.surface: A satellite whose job seems to be passing news to seamen.
explanation.walkthrough: TAR is the old word for a sailor; 'it appears' says the name sounds like 'tells tar'.
explanation.definitionFit: Telstar was the pioneering 1962 communications satellite relaying television across the Atlantic.
